name: PSO Underground / Kuchiyuku Omoide ni
original_name: PSOアンダーグラウンド／朽ちゆく想い出に
source:
Year AUW 3087. Three years after explosion of Central Dome life at planet Raguol has finally come to normal state.

Middle-aged Raymar Jay of the Hunters Guild receives a request from his bad buddy to dig information about the infiltration into a small military center three years ago. Together with former lover and friends protagonist challenges the mystery of the lost past.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-february-2004-forest.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
AUW3087年。中央圆顶爆炸事件过去三年后，拉古奥尔星球上的生活终于恢复了正常。

隶属猎人公会的中年人类游侠杰伊，接到了一位损友的委托，要他调查三年前某座小型军事中心遭人潜入的事件。主人公与昔日恋人和朋友们携手，追寻那段遗失过去中的谜团。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-february-2004-forest.html]vndbreview[/url]]
